Anthony woke up at 6am.
Thomas saw Anthony attending class at the school from 6am to 2pm.
Richard saw Anthony buying lunch at the deli from 2pm to 5pm.

The park was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could Anthony have gone to the park?

Options:
(A) 2pm to 5pm
(B) 5pm to 8pm
(C) 6am to 2pm
(D) 8pm to 9pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- He was at the deli from 2pm to 5pm.
- He was at the library from 5pm to 8pm.

None of these activities overlap with the park being open. The park was closed after 9pm, so Anthony could not have gone to the park during his active times.

- (A) 2pm to 5pm: During this time, Anthony was at the deli.
- (B) 5pm to 8pm: During this time, Anthony was at the library.
- (C) 6am to 2pm: During this time, Anthony was at school.
- (D) 8pm to 9pm: This is after the park was closed.

None of these options include the times when Anthony was active and the park was closed. Therefore, based on the given information, there is no overlap where Anthony could have gone to the park.

Answer: (D)
